# Security Policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

If you find a security vulnerability in Campfire, please report it privately – do not open a public issue.

Email **<joakim.kemeny@scouterna.se>** with:

- a description of the issue and why you believe it is a vulnerability,
- steps to reproduce it, and
- anything that helps us confirm and fix it (affected component, logs, screenshots).

We will acknowledge your report as soon as we can, keep you posted on progress, and let you know when it is resolved. Please give us a reasonable chance to fix the issue before sharing it publicly.

Thank you for helping keep Campfire and its users safe.
